assertions.assertion: The study is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The study was performed to correlate the patient's recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations with underlying rhythm disturbances
The clinical indication note documents concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias as the basis for ordering this study
Diagnosis codes R55, I48.91, and I49.9 support the cardiac evaluation
The Holter monitor is specifically ordered to guide further management of these symptomatic events
